notes: «جميعا عن حاتم» joins the two co-transmitters; the editor gloss between dashes (قال أبو بكر حدثنا حاتم بن إسماعيل المدني) is left out, so حاتم is written as the text first names him
«أنا محمد بن علي بن حسين» is the speaker introducing himself in the scene, not a link
Jabir is the last link: the matn is his own account of the Prophet's Hajj (rule 6), though he is first met in the scene
